name: fugleramme-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Fugleramme, an e-ink bird frame for a Raspberry Pi: it reads the birds that a
BirdNET-Go detector has recognised over BirdNET-Go's HTTP API and renders the recently heard species as a collage
(or a single-bird or newest-arrival page) for an Inky Impression panel, serving the same page and an admin interface
over HTTP. It includes a stand-in detector for development, a detector check, artwork tools and MkDocs hooks.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the fugleramme application: the Python package under src/fugleramme/ (every module, including render/ and web/, and the HTML pages and admin.js under web/static/; the stylesheet admin.css is not in scope), the MkDocs hooks under hooks/, the artwork tools under tools/, the shell scripts install.sh, run.sh and detector/preflight.sh, and the documentation in README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/ and assets/artwork/custom/README.md, together with the docstrings and comments of the in-scope Python modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings and comments, including their examples.

The environment runs Python 3.11 with the repository's locked dependencies installed (all extras
